items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he recorded with Bird: Old Folks and In the Still of the Night, with arrangements by Gil Evans.

ctx.x: Did that affect you at all, his death?

Oh yeah. Very much. I still think of him, because he – when I start to try to find young jazz singers who can scat, I realize what an important presence he was, because he was one of the founders of the bebop school of scatting. In fact he was the one responsible for taking it into that area, the area of Bird, and he did work with Bird at the Royal Roost, and he recorded with Bird: Old Folks and In the Still of the Night, with arrangements by Gil Evans. So he was the quintessential bebop scat singer. When I try…
Was there a big age difference between you and Dave?
